subject: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: staggered invoice & credit guardrails
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@hearthlinehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: proposal and next steps

Alex — following our call this morning, attached is the initial renewal + top-up offer for Hearthline (attached: Hearthline_Renewal_Offer_v1.pdf). Summary: a 20% uplift in reserved units to cover Q1 expected burst, co-term to 2027-11-30, and a staggered invoice option to ease procurement.

Key asks from our side:
- Procurement timeline (PO needed by 12/15 to hit Jan 1 start)
- Any legal non-starters on usage/data residency / SOC2 language

High level options in the PDF:
A) Single invoice, 10% early-payment discount
B) Staggered invoice (3 installments) + 7% uplift credit buffer (preferred for customers wanting cash-smoothing)

Can you confirm which path looks closest? If preferred, I’ll route a staggered schedule to you and loop in legal for an amendment. Priyom — please hold a draft staggered schedule (simple xlsx) so we can iterate quickly.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Hearthline_Renewal_Offer_v1.pdf (13 pages, pricing + SOW)
From: Alex Rivera <alex@hearthlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Hearthline Health Legal <legal@hearthlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: proposal and next steps

Jonas — thanks for the doc. Quick notes from procurement + legal side:
- Procurement prefers the staggered invoice approach (cashflow Q1 constraint).
- Legal flagged the standard data processing appendix — they need explicit SOC2 mention and an indemnity cap tied to contract value.
- We attached a PO template (PO_Hearthline_2026-12-02.pdf) that procurement will use if we can land the staggered schedule.

I’m fine with the 7% uplift credit buffer you suggested if we can get the amendment signed by 12/20. Can you send the staggered schedule and the amendment wording so our counsel can review?

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Director, Platform Operations | Hearthline Health
alex@hearthlinehealth.com
Attachment: PO_Hearthline_2026-12-02.pdf (purchase order template)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@hearthlinehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: proposal and next steps

Alex — great, thanks for the clear constraints. Attached is the staggered invoice schedule (staggered-invoice-schedule.xlsx) that lays out 3 equal invoices: 12/31/2026, 02/15/2027, 04/01/2027, with the 7% uplift credit applied to the second invoice as a safeguard against burst overage. High-level changes we will put in the amendment:
- Co-term to 2027-11-30 (same as draft)
- Staggered invoice schedule (dates above)
- Credit guardrail: 7% of uplifted units available as a one-time cushion applied to invoice 2 if usage exceeds forecasts
- SOC2 reference added to the DPA; indemnity cap language flagged for legal negotiation (we will propose cap = annual contract value).

Priyom — can you confirm that the staggered schedule preserves our revenue recognition matrix and that finance is OK with the dates? Kimberly — can you prepare an amendment draft that includes the SOC2 line and the indemnity cap we can send to Hearthline legal?

If good, I’ll push a DocuSign link for an amendment (we’ll use the deal id D-2026-0897).

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: staggered-invoice-schedule.xlsx (3-row schedule + notes)
From: Alex Rivera <alex@hearthlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Hearthline Health Legal <legal@hearthlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: proposal and next steps

Jonas / Kimberly / Priyom — we reviewed the staggered schedule and the guardrail concept internally. Two fast items from legal:
1) Confirm SOC2 inclusion: we need the exact SOC2 report cadence (annual) called out and a right to request a copy within 30 days of request.
2) Indemnity cap — Hearthline legal would like the cap set at 1x ARR. Our counsel says anything higher is hard for them; will you accept 1x ARR or propose language for insurance-backed carveouts?

On pricing: procurement is willing to accept the 7% uplift credit as-is if the amendment is in DocuSign by EOD 12/15. Otherwise they ask we move to a 5% credit.

We can sign quickly once SOC2 cadence + indemnity cap are in the amendment.

—Alex

(legal@hearthlinehealth.com is looping their counsel for final redlines)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@hearthlinehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-contract top-up: proposal and next steps

Alex — appreciate the specificity. Quick internal summary and next steps:
- SOC2: Kimberly will insert language that references an annual SOC2 report and Redwood will commit to making the current report available within 30 days of written request.
- Indemnity cap: our standard approach is 1x ARR for platform customers; we can accept 1x ARR here. If Hearthline requests carveouts, we will handle on a case-by-case basis with insurance-backed assurances.
- Pricing: we will hold the 7% uplift credit provided the amendment is signed by 12/15; after that it steps to 5%.

Action items:
- Kimberly to deliver amendment draft including SOC2 clause and indemnity cap (attached: amendment_for_signature.pdf) — internal draft for review today.
- Priyom to prepare final DocuSign envelope (link to be generated) and confirm revenue scheduling with finance.
- Monica (CS) — please prioritize the uplift onboarding plan and stand by for a Jan 4 technical kickoff.

Alex — I will send the DocuSign link as soon as legal signs off on the final wording. Appreciate the fast turnaround from your team.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
